:::{#exm-exponential}
#### Probability of an event within one time unit

Let $T$ be exponential with rate $\rate$.
The probability that $T$ falls in $[0, 1]$ is:

$$
\ba
\Pr(0 \le T \le 1)
&= \int_0^1 \rate \ef{-\rate t}\,dt
&& \text{(definition of a density)} \\
&= \sb{-\ef{-\rate t}}_{t=0}^{1}
&& \text{(antiderivative of } \rate \ef{-\rate t} \text{)} \\
&= 1 - \ef{-\rate}
&& \text{(evaluate at the bounds)}
\ea
$$

With $\rate = 0.5$, for example, $\Pr(0 \le T \le 1) = 1 - \ef{-0.5} \approx 0.393$.

:::
